content.comment_body: I have a program in my [product_name] [article_no] PLC device. I'd like to copy it to another device, but it's password protected and I've forgotten the password. Is there any way to bypass or recover this password? Please help.

Hello. Unfortunately, it is only possible to redevelop the program from one device to another. You cannot access the program itself due to password protection. The complete [article_no] of the [product_name] 6 device (whether pure or basic) is required. You might want to search the forum for similar topics.

analysis.insight_summary: There is an issue with gaining access to or transferring programs from a [product_name] [article_no] PLC device due to a forgotten password. Users are looking for solutions to bypass or recover the password, but currently such options do not exist, leading to frustration and interrupted workflows.
